# Commissioning checklist: printer_v8

Generated by `tools/build_package.py` from `designs/printer_v8.py` (md5 `9f4017d87957e199a7069390d97496bc`) and `out/printer_v8/report.json` (written 2026-11-15 18:53:15, md5 `1d5bf219132d`). Do not edit: change the design, re-run verify, re-run the generator.

> **Simulated design. Nothing has been built.** See [OPEN_ITEMS.md](OPEN_ITEMS.md) before spending money.

Ordered: bench tests before assembly (B), mechanical checks with the power off (M), first power-up and calibration (E). Every step has what the simulation predicts and an acceptance range. **Write the measured value down in every row, pass or fail: this first build is the experiment that tests the digital twin.** `commissioning_record.csv` is the same table for filling in.

Predictions come from `report.json`, `scores.jsonl` (2026-11-15T18:52:23) and `tune/tuning.json`; none is typed here. Acceptance ranges that are not the twin's own range or a limit in the design are engineering judgement written in the generator and say so by their form (a +/- percentage).

> **MAINS VOLTAGE. This design has NOT been safety-certified, tested or inspected by anyone.** The mains side (inlet, fuse, relay module, supply terminals, protective earth) must be wired, or checked before first power, by a person competent to do so under your local rules. The electrical verifier checks ratings and that the wires exist; it does not check creepage, enclosure, strain relief, touch protection, or any standard.

| B1 | **Probe switching distance on the real print surface (do this BEFORE anything else is built).** Lay the real stack on the bench: plate (or any aluminium plate), magnetic sheet, print sheet. Power the sensor from 24 V, watch its LED / output. | Lower the sensor square onto the sheet on a height gauge or a stack of feeler gauges; note the gap at which it switches on. Repeat at the centre, 12 mm from an edge and over a post head position. Cold (room temperature). | 5 mm nominal (OMRON's figure for a 1 mm iron target), 4.5 to 5.5 mm over unit spread | **PASS as designed: >= 2.98 mm** at every point (= (face height 2 + margin 0.68) / (1 - 0.1 temperature drift)). Between 1.52 and 2.98 mm: usable only with the sensor set lower (new face height = (0.9 x measured) / 2) and the design re-verified. Below 1.52 mm: this sensor cannot be used on this sheet. |  |  | change the sheet (thicker steel), the sensor (longer range) or the probe type before ordering the rest | `subsystems.homing.z (sensing_distance_mm, face_above_nozzle_mm, probe_to_nozzle_margin, temperature_drift_frac)` |
